llm_analysis.reasoning: The role does not require ML, which removes the profile's strongest area as a differentiator, and the three owned responsibilities (reliability on cloud nodes, real-time ingestion with gaps, run observability) have only partial or adjacent backing. The JD is explicitly flexible on years and stresses learning ability and buildable software, and COFFIN plus the visualization tools give a credible portfolio, so applying is reasonable but the screen risk is production-ownership and cloud depth.
